name: Buy Me a Coffee
description: Embeds the third-party Buy Me a Coffee donation button (as a block) and floating support widget (site-wide), driven by an admin-configured account username.
project_description: The Buy Me a Coffee module integrates the hosted Buy Me a Coffee donation/tipping platform into a Drupal site without custom code. It renders two things from the platform's official CDN scripts: a customizable donation button (exposed as a placeable block plugin) and an optional floating support widget attached to every non-admin page. All appearance and account settings live in one config form; the module makes no server-side API calls itself — the button and widget scripts run in the visitor's browser and link through to the configured Buy Me a Coffee account. Typical users are content creators, independent artists, and small non-profits who want a low-friction way for their audience to send small donations.
